_comment: Record of Advice report for a completed broker-portal FNA. Insert this document into the 'reports' collection of the primary mongo database (application.json -> mongo.database / mongo.report_table, i.e. blueasset.reports). It reads the 'fna' collection from the 'broker_portal' database via the 'broker_portal' connection (see mongo_connections in application.json), joins the client / advisor / brokerage and the latest SUBMITTED quote linked to the FNA (quotes.fna_id), then a JS action reshapes it into data.record_of_advice for reports/record_of_advice.html. The report is 'unavailable' until a quote is linked. Run it with GET /run?name=record-of-advice&fna_id=<hex ObjectID> (add &type=pdf for the PDF variant).
name: record-of-advice
description: FAIS Record of Advice for a completed Financial Needs Analysis.

parameters.name: fna_id
parameters.description: The FNA _id (hex ObjectID) to produce the Record of Advice for.
